statement: Every actual section of the full profinite extension of a nonidentity pure pants involution is self-centralizing: for the three labelled D34 representatives s_i, C_F(s_i)=1 and N_E(<s_i>)=<s_i>. Twisted relative duality gives an exact half-dimension rank for boundary restriction with every finite self-dual F2 coefficient module; the triangle and full Brown restriction force each normalizer-to-section map onto, and finite coset modules detect every possible nontrivial commuter. The extension is real projective by Haran's exact criterion. The D34 coboundary is unique in the full group; for GT0 it is the same unique first-symmetry solution of D44.
depends_on: D34 actual global multiplier minus one, normalized lift, three full section classes, full peripheral normalizers and labelled triangle; A7 full cusp subgroups and free profinite cohomological dimension; C-WilkesRelativeAccepted2018 Definition 2.1, Propositions 2.3-2.4, 2.10, 3.1, 3.5, 5.7 and 6.16; A-KochloukovaZalesskii2007 Theorem 2 and Section 1.1 for every finite discrete primary module; C-HaranArtinSchreier1993 Proposition 2.2 and R-PalQuick2025 Definition 1.1/Theorem 2.1; D35 exact peripheral-conjugator parametrization and D44 first-symmetry existence; all augmentation, coefficient, cup, cyclic cochain, spectral-sequence, conjugation-transport and finite-quotient maps proved explicitly here
manuscript_passages: Section 30, folios 194-196, scans 383-387; Section 31, folios 198-199 verso, scans 391-394; Section 24, folio 147 verso, scan 293; Part D(b), full loop-outer finite actions in type (0,3)
depends_on_doubtful_reading: None. The actual coset module for E/D_j restricts by an explicit homeomorphism to the full pants peripheral module F/L_j. No relative extension theorem requiring F to lie in a peripheral subgroup is used. The ordinary LHS sequence is applied to the exact Hom(Delta,M) coefficient module, and every comparison preserves the original quotient generator, cusp and section labels.
computational_checks: No computational claim. The positive cyclic cochain differential, perfect quotient pairing, d2 transpose identity, actual localized long exact sequence, bar-prism transport and separating finite coset-module witness are proved for all relevant modules and finite quotients in the text. Root and part_a_continue independently audited the complete proof and primary sources.
notes: The transgressions are not assumed to vanish. Their equal ranks are derived from the actual absolute-relative cup product and Poincare-Lefschetz duality of the full completed surface pair. The finite permutation witness can detect an element with no ordinary mod-two abelian image. The new accepted-version Wilkes bibliography entry identifies the exact June 19, 2018 numbering and published DOI without altering earlier preprint citations. D.74 removes the full fixed-subgroup variable from D.35, but leaves the exact equation x^mu h y^mu h^-1 = u(xy)^mu u^-1 unresolved. No free-product decomposition, full peripheral conjugacy, or exhaustion of the pants involution orbit is inferred from real projectivity.
